title: Grand Hall Aisle
desc: A grand hall aisle lined with lush florals under chandeliers, facing a cream draped stage with neon lettering.

groups.label: Feature flowers
groups.blurb: The white-pink-purple mix climbing both sides of the aisle.

items.role: White roses massed through the aisle arrangements.
Pink roses woven between the white blooms.
White ranunculus adding rounded layered faces.
Pink ranunculus echoing the rose tones.
Purple hydrangea heads anchoring the taller clusters.
Pink hydrangea lightening the palette.
White larkspur spikes giving vertical lift.
Small yellow sunflower faces dotted into the greenery (form-match for the small sunflower accents).
Orange spray roses warming the lower arrangements (closest orange multi-head rose).

groups.label: Fillers
groups.blurb: Small faces and airy fills between the feature blooms.

items.role: White baby's breath scattering through the mixes.
Small purple daisies adding tiny violet faces (form-match for small purple chrysanth types).
Yellow mini daisies as the small yellow filler blooms.
White statice filling gaps with fine texture.

groups.label: Foliage & grasses
groups.blurb: The lush green base building the aisle plantings.

items.role: Fountain grass plumes adding airy movement at the edges.
Dark green pine spray giving fine needle texture.
Eucalyptus sprigs through the middle layer.
Asparagus fern adding soft feathery volume.
Fine trailing grass tails over the arrangement edges (form-match trailing grass).
Monstera leaves giving broad tropical structure at the base.

groups.label: Styling & props
groups.blurb: The cream drape, pearl detailing and candlelight of the stage.

items.role: Cream milk-silk backdrop drape with gathered swags behind the stage.
Pearl mesh runner detailing along the aisle styling.
White pillar candles for the ceremony glow (chandeliers, neon sign, string lights, paper flower installs and plush carpet are venue fixtures — logged gap).
